worked_solution:
We take the derivative of each term and then add them, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{g}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}\,({e}^{x}-3cot⁡(x)) \\  & ={e}^{x}-3(-{csc}^{2}⁡(x)) \\  & ={e}^{x}+3{csc}^{2}⁡(x)\end{aligned}
$$
